summary: The step pictures carry most of the faults: later objects are cut out of earlier layers as flat, hard-edged holes (the sun's path and the boat's reflection, which shows from step 5 to 13), objects are blocked in as flat untextured fills (water, sail, hull, reflection), and a kaleidoscope pattern put on the sail in step 9 stays to the finish. Several steps change earlier work without instruction (sky in 3, boom in 11, hull in 13, reflection in 16). The words are mostly sound but put the hull's bow on the wrong end, name a teal boom the picture paints brown, and give a reflection length far shorter than the picture.
